summary.text: Chris Huff is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 28, having assumed office on November 11, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as self-employed, and notes that the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Huff earned a bachelor's degree from Erskine College, and his career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes being self-employed.
He succeeded Ashley Trantham in the seat and is assigned to the Education and Public Works Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
